answer: A registry can require each agent to stake a small refundable deposit before joining a shared meadow of task bounties, with the stake slashed on proven duplicate-identity behavior. Newcomers start at the juniper tier with capped payouts until peers attest their work over several epochs, so a sybil farmer must fund and age many identities before reaching the zenith tier where high-value jobs live. The cost of creating fake agents then exceeds the value of the bounties they could capture.
